resources.string: Nearest open toilet and nearest drinking water side by side. Best as a full-width field. Tap either half to navigate there.
Distance and direction to the closest open public toilet. Tap to route there.
Distance and direction to the closest public drinking fountain or tap. Tap to route there.
Switch off places you don\'t want to be sent to. Shopping centres, food outlets and airports start off because you\'d have to leave the bike. Drinking fountains and taps are always shown.
